description: Server versions every SDK must run its integration suite against (ITG-030). Update when the minimum supported server or the latest release changes.

servers.notes: Minimum supported server. Endpoints introduced later must skip with 'requires server >= X' (ITG-031).
Latest released server. Pull requests run against this entry.
Nightly only; failures are reported, not blocking.

environment.BASTIONVAULT_TEST_ADDR: External server address; when unset the harness starts a managed server.
environment.BASTIONVAULT_TEST_ROOT_TOKEN: Root token for the external server.
environment.BASTIONVAULT_TEST_CACERT: CA bundle path for the external server (optional).
environment.BASTIONVAULT_TEST_NAMESPACE: Namespace to run tenant-scoped scenarios in (optional).
environment.BASTIONVAULT_TEST_TLS_SKIP_VERIFY: Set to 1 only for dev servers with self-signed certificates.
environment.BASTIONVAULT_TEST_BIN: Path to a bvault binary to use instead of a container image (managed mode).
environment.BASTIONVAULT_TEST_IMAGE: Override the container image for managed mode.
